nom: medicube PDRN Pink Peptide Eye Serum

avis.texte: I made a decent size order a while back but never received this item. When making a bigger order, make sure they send you all your products to avoid being charged for something you never received
This has taken my dryer creapy , fine lines under my eyes and really changed them for the better. very hydrating but light weight lays well under concealer / makeup

avis.titre: I would buy this product again.
avis.texte: It can be drying & can cause bags under your eyes if you have sensitive skin. I put a light layer of the serum on & follow it with the CeraVe eye repair cream to combat the negative effects I experienced. So far it seems to be a great combination.
This is the perfect moisturizer to go under my foundation. It goes on smoothly and gives my foundation staying power. What a find!
Been using for a couple days now and have noticed a difference
this product is great! Very moisturizing, and a little goes a long way!
I've used this product 3x and has done the complete opposite of olum and hydrate. It has just caused redness, dryness and possible chemical burns :(
This cream doesnt sting my eyes or cause any reaction (i have very sensitive eyelids, so that is a plus). It is moisturizing and works just fine, it just doesnt have any other benefits.
I really like this product and find to to be great as an evening eye cream. I have repurchased to replace my empty.
I reslly like this eye cream. Makes my eye feel hydrated in the am . I do feel like my ubder eye bags are down in the morning as well .

I have been using it for 3 days. It has dried out the skin under my eyes causing more lines, turned my cheeks red and caused a bag under my right eye. I have never had anything like this happen before
Been using this cream consistently for 6 weeks now and no results, at all. Was holing to see at least something. Zero! Doesnt work for me. Im back on the market looking for another eye serum.
This underye cream is so soft. No residue left so when i put on makeup it doesnt feel cakey. Love the texture

This is the best eye cream. The way it has brightened and hydrated my eyes in only 2 weeks. My very fine lines have diminished and i feel like my eyes dont look as tired amd dull. I have even started using around my laugh lines and notice a difference.
I don't believe in the magic of eye cream, but i really enjoy this one. Very hydrating, great value for the amount of product, and easy to use packaging.

I don't usually leave product reviews, but feel compelled to for this eye cream. The first time I tried it I saw my under eye area look firmer and brighter shortly after applying. The second time I tried, I took photos and observed that the eye with the cream applied had a noticeable, visible difference compared to the eye that did not. Amazing!! Also the tube is HUGE relative to the amount that needs to be applied - I'm pretty sure I have a lifetime supply of eye cream now ;)

avis.titre: One of the best I've used
avis.texte: This is one of the best eye creams i have used. Minimizes kines, dark circles and moisturizes.
Love this eye treatment! I works well with all my skincare and makeup. Keeps undereyes hydrated all day.
